def main():
 global F
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--config',required=True);ap.add_argument('--sha256',required=True);args=ap.parse_args();affinity()
 cp=Path(args.config).resolve();assert cp.is_relative_to(R/'work/oq56')
 cfg=bound(cp,args.sha256);assert cfg['explicit_lead_permission'] is True and cfg['mode'] in ['author','target','audit']
 assert fp(Path(__file__))['sha256']==cfg['runner_sha256']
 duration=timeout_seconds(cfg);assert cfg['mode']=='author' or not cfg.get('resolved_timeouts')
 mode=cfg['mode'];label=cfg['label'];assert re.fullmatch('[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,40}',label)
 U=Path(cfg['unit_directory']).resolve();assert U.is_relative_to(R/'work/oq56') and U.is_dir()
 F=U/label;assert not F.exists()
 lock=(R/'work/oq56/HEAVY.lock').open('a+b');fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 S=Path(cfg['source_path']).resolve();assert S.suffix=='.lean' and S.is_relative_to(R)
 if mode!='audit':assert S.is_relative_to(R/'Shao/OQ5') or S.is_relative_to(R/'Shao/OQ6')
 sb=S.read_bytes();assert len(sb)==cfg['source_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(sb).hexdigest()==cfg['source_sha256'] and len(sb.splitlines())==cfg['source_lines']
 assert bytes([13]) not in sb and sb.endswith(bytes([10])) and not sb.endswith(bytes([10,10])) and not sb.startswith(bytes([239,187,191]))
 assert b'set_option autoImplicit false' in sb and not re.search(rb'\b(sorry|admit|axiom|unsafe|native_decide|implemented_by|extern)\b',sb)
 if 'prefix_of_source' in cfg:
  original=Path(cfg['prefix_of_source']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()==cfg['canonical_source_sha256'] and sb.startswith(original)
  assert re.findall(rb'(?m)^import\s+(\S+)',sb)==[x.encode() for x in cfg['canonical_imports']]
 owned_import=cfg.get('owned_object_module')
 if owned_import:
  assert mode=='audit' and 'prefix_of_source' not in cfg
  assert re.findall(rb'(?m)^import\s+(\S+)',sb)==[owned_import.encode()]
  own_source=R/(owned_import.replace('.', '/')+'.lean');own_object=R/'.lake/build/lib/lean'/(owned_import.replace('.', '/')+'.olean')
  assert cfg['records'][str(own_source)]['sha256']==cfg['owned_source_sha256'] and cfg['records'][str(own_object)]['sha256']==cfg['owned_object_sha256']
  assert cfg['check_modes'][str(own_source)]==cfg['check_modes'][str(own_object)]=='FULL_SHA_BYTES_NS'
 A=S;ab=sb;O=Path(cfg['object_path']).resolve() if mode=='author' else None
 if mode=='author':
  assert O==R/'.lake/build/lib/lean'/S.relative_to(R).with_suffix('.olean') and O.parent.is_dir()
  assert not(U/'AUTHOR-STOP.json').exists()
  resolved_records=prior_author_attempts(U,cfg)
  assert (fp(O) if O.exists() else None)==cfg['object_before']
 records=dict(cfg['records']);modes=dict(cfg['check_modes'])
 for e in resolved_records if mode=='author' else []:
  k=e['physical_path']
  if k in records:assert records[k]==e
  records[k]=e;modes[k]='FULL_SHA_BYTES_NS'
 for p in [S,cp,Path(__file__)]:
  k=str(p);e=fp(p)
  if k in records:assert records[k]==e
  records[k]=e;modes[k]='FULL_SHA_BYTES_NS'
 def snapshot():
  affinity();actual={}
  for q,e in records.items():
   p=Path(q);st=p.stat();assert st.st_size==e['bytes'] and str(st.st_mtime_ns)==e['mtime_ns'],q
   if modes[q]=='FULL_SHA_BYTES_NS':assert fp(p)==e,q
   else:assert modes[q] in ['SEALED_SOURCE_OBJECT_SHA_REFERENCE_CURRENT_BYTES_NS','UNCHANGED_ACCEPTED_SHA_REFERENCE_BYTES_NS']
   actual[q]=e
  gs=gitstate();assert gs==cfg['expected_git'] and git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no')==''
  return {'records':actual,'git':gs,'CPU':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))}
 F.mkdir();inp=F/(label+'-input.lean')
 with inp.open('xb') as h:h.write(sb)
 before=snapshot();resource=resources()
 cmd=['taskset','-c','52-55','lake','env','lean','-M','8192','-j','4']
 if mode=='author':cmd+=['-o',str(O)]
 cmd+=[S.relative_to(R).as_posix()];assert ('-o' in cmd)==(mode=='author')
 started={'unit':cfg['unit'],'mode':mode,'label':label,'utc':now(),'command':cmd,'input':fp(inp),'config':fp(cp),'before':before,'resource':resource,'no_o':mode!='author','own_object_import':bool(owned_import),'process_control_origin':cfg['process_control_origin'],'timeout_seconds':duration,'resolved_timeouts':cfg.get('resolved_timeouts',[])}
